title: A number used as an IF condition is TRUE unless it is 0

source.quote: Any value or expression that can be evaluated to TRUE or FALSE .
source.supports: the condition is converted to a boolean

source.quote: DAX implicitly converts TRUE to the number 1
source.supports: TRUE and 1 convert to each other; 0 is FALSE

derivation: TRUE is 1 and FALSE is 0, so the number 0 converts to FALSE and a non-zero number to TRUE: IF ( 2, ... ) takes the first branch and IF ( 0, ... ) the second.
alternative: The pages say the condition is converted but do not state the rule for numbers outright. If a number were not accepted as a condition the query would fail with an error.
